Both p-values are stored as 0.0000000000 with display_digits 4, which renders as a p of exactly zero. The release should show a bound such as p < 0.0001; my recompute gives z = 26.72 and Welch t = 42.70, so p underflows to zero in double precision.
Bonferroni is named on both tests, but the adjusted per-test alpha of 0.025 is written nowhere in the register or the answers; the conclusion does not change because both p-values are below 1e-10.
